title: ae/windows-desktop-configuration
description: The application's settings for windows-desktop: the DesktopSettings passed to start and the paths passed to build.

webRoot.description: The packaged web build (resources/web) the window serves; for build, the generated web project that holds the build:desktop script. Absolute path on the running platform.

scheme.description: Lower-case custom scheme the window loads from; not http, https, file, data or javascript.

modeEvent.description: Window event name that display-mode fires when document.documentElement.dataset.mode changes.

serverOrigin.description: Exact origin of the server (no path, no credentials, no trailing slash); https, or http only for localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1].

items.description: https origin with no path or credentials.

externalOrigins.description: Origins the window may open in the system browser after a recent user action.

outputRoot.description: Where build writes the desktop web build (desktop/build/web); must not overlap webRoot or webRoot/dist-desktop. Absolute path on the running platform.
